entities.name: Query polyamine aminopropyltransferase
observations: The 291-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q8ZXM4 from Pyrobaculum aerophilum.
Predicted molecular mass is 32.8 kDa and theoretical pI is 6.01.
Pfam domains Spermine_synt_N (PF17284) and Spermine_synth (PF01564) support membership in the polyamine aminopropyltransferase family.
Reference annotation reports a cytoplasmic homodimer or homotetramer with active-site proton acceptor at position 164.

entities.name: Spermidine synthesis
observations: Decarboxy-AdoMet transfers a 3-aminopropyl group to putrescine, producing spermidine, S-methyl-5'-thioadenosine, and a proton.
Mapped to EC 2.5.1.16 and Rhea RHEA:12721.
This reaction is curated for close reviewed homologs and is the canonical spermidine-synthase activity.

entities.name: Thermospermine synthesis
observations: Decarboxy-AdoMet transfers a 3-aminopropyl group to spermidine, producing thermospermine, S-methyl-5'-thioadenosine, and a proton.
Mapped to Rhea RHEA:30515 and EC 2.5.1.126 in the exact-match reference.
The exact-match archaeal annotation also reports activity with norspermidine to form norspermine and lower activity toward longer polyamines.

entities.name: Decarboxy-AdoMet
observations: Acts as the aminopropyl donor; chemically S-adenosyl 3-(methylsulfanyl)propylamine.
The donor is converted to S-methyl-5'-thioadenosine during aminopropyl transfer.
